The Cricket on the Hearth

Annotated: A Fairy Tale of Home

John Peerybingle the carrier, his young wife Dot and the cricket that chirps on their hearth face a test of love and trust in this short Christmas book from 1845.

This annotated edition explains the history behind the story.

Questions

What does annotated mean?

The book includes extra notes alongside the story, such as explanations of the history and customs that a modern reader might not know.

Who wrote it?

Charles Dickens. The text is his complete original story.
